name: io.github.AetherAI3/agent-browser
description: Self-hosted Chrome for AI agents, with a live noVNC view a human can take over.

packageArguments.description: Start the Agent Browser MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_BROWSER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Agent Browser server. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8092.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_BROWSER_CONTROLLER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Controller token, if the server runs authenticated.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_BROWSER_OBSERVER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Observer token for read-only health and snapshot calls.
